indices.name: S&P 500
indices.note: Slipped about 17 points, a fifth straight losing day.

indices.name: Nasdaq
indices.note: Gained about 102 points as chipmakers and AI names firmed ahead of Anthropic's debut.

indices.name: Dow
indices.note: Fell about 561 points, dragged down by UnitedHealth and other health insurers.

notes: Health insurers slumped for a second day after Medicare proposed a tougher anti-fraud audit rule; UnitedHealth, Humana, CVS and Cigna all fell, weighing heavily on the Dow.
Nvidia gave back an early post-earnings gain and closed down roughly 3%, while the Nasdaq still edged up as investors looked ahead to Anthropic's IPO, which reportedly priced above its $70–78 range.

Minutes from the Fed's October meeting showed nearly all officials saw further rate hikes as likely appropriate; Target rose after beating estimates with help from tariff refunds, and the 10-year yield stayed near 5.07%.
events: Thu 19 Nov: Anthropic is expected to begin trading on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT.
